title: Reader mode (examples/extensions/reader-mode): a news article becomes clean, readable text, and the same command turns it back

steps.title: Pack the Reader mode example, then cmux ext dev --once loads it into this cmux
cmux: clear; export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"; cd {repo}/examples/extensions/reader-mode && { command -v bun >/dev/null && bun {repo}/cmux-tui/crates/cmux-app-host/tools/pack.ts . || { mkdir -p dist && cp test/packed/main.js dist/main.js; }; } && cmux ext dev --once --no-install

steps.title: Install it: the install card asks for browser:execute
A news article in a browser tab
Reader Mode: Toggle (the command its key runs): the article as clean text
Scrolled down: text and images inline, no ads, menus or popups
Reader Mode: Toggle again: the page is back as it was
